Table base is at a1+0x10, entry count at a1+0xC, each 20-byte entry carrying lower bound at +4 and upper bound at +8. Writes the found entry index and the previous index through a4/a5 and returns a pointer to the matching entry; calls SEHGuardedFunctionPointerCall on the sentinel and bounds-failure paths.

Return the pointer to the matched entry: v7 + 20 * v9.
